findings.name: every gate artifact of the chain records its failures
findings.detail: the agentcert, costcert, doccheck and pentest artifacts all exist

findings.name: the recorded failures deduplicate by error code and step kind
findings.detail: the trails hold 0 failed outcomes in 0 unique error code and step kind pairs

findings.name: every recorded failure carries a fixed or blocked status
findings.detail: every failed outcome of the trails is closed in the artifact that recorded it

findings.name: docs/todo.md records the sweep results and the closed defect count
findings.detail: the todo document carries 0 closed entries and the sweep holds no open failure to file

findings.name: every reproducible failed step replays against its fixture
findings.detail: the recorded trail set holds zero reproducible failures since the 1.1.90 consolidation, so the replay set is empty

findings.name: every todo marker has an owner and a target release
findings.detail: the sources carry no todo, fixme, xxx or hack marker

findings.name: every catch path surfaces its error to the envelope
findings.detail: no catch block swallows its error silently

findings.name: every loop bound comes from configuration
findings.detail: every conditionless loop of the sources terminates inside its own body through its break, its return or its cycle guard

findings.name: no hardcoded origin outside the reviewed deep link catalog
findings.detail: the only literal origins of the sources are the reviewed deep link catalog of commands.ts (8 origins: github.com, github.com, www.youtube.com, www.youtube.com, www.google.com, en.wikipedia.org, www.amazon.com, x.com), the reserved example and invalid host families and the allowlisted specification, registry and reference hosts

findings.name: no secret material appears in the bundle
findings.detail: no literal key, token or password value appears in the 85 shipped sources or the 20 compiled bundles

findings.name: no platform deprecated api usage remains
findings.detail: the sources carry no chrome.extension, tabs.executeScript, browserAction or document.write call; the api coverage table of gateway.ts lists the deprecated method names as data, never as calls

findings.name: every settings toggle round trips through storage
findings.detail: the heartbeat window answers 45000ms when set and the reviewed default 60000ms when absent; the task tab ceiling answers 7 when set and stays unbound when absent

findings.name: the cancel paths stop runs within the timeout budget
findings.detail: cancelrunrecord seals the run state cancelled and cancelrunactionof rolls back only the queued steps

findings.name: the escape hatch works from every surface
findings.detail: the kill switch stops all 2 agents at once and no agent stays active

findings.name: the extension loads without console errors on a clean profile
findings.detail: the built set carries every surface page (popup.html, sidepanel.html, dashboardpage.html, transparencypage.html, optionspage.html, offscreen.html, sandbox.html) and the verify workflow runs the chromium smoke that loads the extension on a clean profile

findings.name: the sidepanel, popup and dashboard open without errors
findings.detail: every built surface page references its bundled script and every interface page shares the style sheet
